name: vscode-round-trip
description: One key hops to the definition, and from there back to the declaration. The round trip, on Alt+G.

commands.title: Round Trip: Go to related symbol

roundTrip.chain.markdownDescription:
Which language-server providers to ask, in order. The first one that answers with a location other than the one under the cursor wins - that is what makes the jump a round trip rather than a one-way trip. On a call site `definition` answers immediately; standing on the definition itself it can only point at where you already are, so the next link in the chain takes over and lands you on the declaration.

Drop `implementation` if your project is mostly free functions and the extra query is wasted. Add `typeDefinition` if you want the key to fall through to the type of the symbol when nothing else answers.

roundTrip.pickWhenAmbiguous.markdownDescription: When a provider answers with several locations - overloads, or a virtual with many overrides - show a picker. Turn this off to always take the first result and never be interrupted.
